data.summary: Landed via PR #97 (squash 8e93fac). store.LeaseClaimID is the one lease-path parser (inverse of leasePath via a shared validClaimID predicate — writer and both readers hold one definition); the store loader and syncer replayTreeAt both use it. Malformed paths (suffix-less, nested, leases/.json, backslash, dotdot) now skip in both readers, erring toward the missing-lease lapsed verdict; valid paths parse identically (leasePath round-trip pinned). TestLeaseClaimID tables the parser; TestMergeReplaySkipsMalformedLeasePaths proves loader and merge-time replay agree on a salted tree, and fails deterministically with the blind parser restored. make test lint green. Binary changed: rebuilt and daemon restarted post-finish.
